account.title: Account
account.q1: How do I change my password?
account.a1: Open the account menu and select Settings. For email/password accounts, enter your current and new password. For Google or Facebook logins, request a password reset link via email.
account.q2: How do I update parent information?
account.a2: Open the account menu and select Parent Profile. You can edit your display name, email, or phone number here.
account.q3: What if I don't receive the verification email?
account.a3: Check your spam folder and verify the email address. For pending email changes, go to Parent Profile to resend the verification email.

children.title: Child profile
children.q1: How do I add a child profile?
children.a1: Open Child Profiles from the navigation or account menu, then select the option to create a new profile and enter the required information.
children.q2: How do I update child information?
children.a2: Open Child Profiles, select the profile, and use the edit function on the page.

books.title: Books and recognition
books.q1: How do I select a book?
books.a1: Open the book catalog, select a book, and follow the on-screen instructions to begin.
books.q2: What should I do if recognized page text is inaccurate?
books.a2: You can submit feedback on this page with the book title, page number, and a description of the inaccurate text so ViRead can review and update it.

reading.title: Reading session
reading.q1: How do I start a reading session?
reading.a1: Select a book from the catalog and follow the preparation steps before entering the reading screen. Please ensure the correct child profile is selected when prompted.
reading.q2: Why does the browser need microphone access?
reading.a2: ViRead requires the microphone to recognize your child's speech during reading sessions. Please grant permission when prompted by the browser and check your device settings.
reading.q3: How can I view my child's reading results?
reading.a3: Open the Progress section to view reports or the History section to see saved reading sessions.
